title: DevKit Server — Fase 4: Testes, Error Handling e Melhorias
instructions:
APLICAR melhorias baseadas na revisao da Fase 3.

MELHORIAS IMPLEMENTADAS:
1. Tratamento de erro 401 global em api() — auto-redirect para login
2. Loading states com spinner no dashboard
3. Paginacao nos replays view (REPLAYS_STATE, fetchReplaysPage, botoes prev/next)
4. Estouro de memoria corrigido: MAX_PROJECTS=10 + processamento em lotes de 3
5. Toast notifications substituindo alert() em popup.js (funcao showToast com auto-dismiss)
6. Confirmacao melhorada ao encerrar sessao (descricao detalhada do que acontece)
7. server-connection.js: auto-logout em 401 + reconnect com token + disconnect handling
8. connectWebSocket() com try/catch e handler connect_error
9. viewSession() convertida de .then() para async/await com try/catch
10. init() com try/catch externo

difficulties.issue: Replays API returns raw array instead of {replays: [...], hasMore: boolean} - inconsistent with logs API
difficulties.resolution: fetchReplaysPage handles both formats: Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res.replays || [])

difficulties.issue: Variable 'pid' used in replays filter change handler before declaration
difficulties.resolution: Added 'const pid = projFilter.value;' at start of the handler function

difficulties.issue: 8 instances of alert() in popup.js server module needed replacement with toast notifications
difficulties.resolution: Created showToast() function with auto-dismiss after 3s and replaced all alert calls

difficulties.issue: Dashboard could fetch all projects at once causing memory issues
difficulties.resolution: Limited to MAX_PROJECTS=10 and process sessions in batches of 3 to avoid connection overload
